deploy-bot: [deploy] Starting staging deploy
env: staging
commit: 0a1b2c3d4e (author: @elena)
tag: v2.8.1-staging-rc4
initiated_by: @elena
change_window: 30m
runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/staging-deploy-ride-along
artifacts: https://ci.internal/builds/4587

elena: Watching, will run quick smoke when canary flips. :eyes:

marc: Any DB migrations or manual steps?

deploy-bot: No DB migrations. Config + model swap only (reranker update).

priya: Kicking off smoke harness now (endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/rerank).

priya: Smoke report: /v1/generate 200 OK, p50=95ms, p95=210ms. /v1/rerank 1x 500 observed on canary pod, reproducing locally.

ops-oncall: Seeing a small spike in 500s for rerank on new pods (0.8%). Traces point to vectorizer timeout ~250ms.

elena: Hold traffic at 10% for now. @deploy-bot keep canary pinned, do not advance until we get green or 10m timeout.

marc: ACK

deploy-bot: Traffic shifted to 10% -> v2.8.1-staging-rc4; pinned canary per @elena.

priya: Applied model config tweak (increased vectorizer timeout to 600ms) and reloaded config on canary.

priya: Re-running smoke: /v1/rerank now 200 OK, no errors in 5 runs. Latency up slightly but within SLO.

ops-oncall: Metrics look stable, 500s back down to baseline (~0.02%). No resource pressure on canary nodes.

elena: Good, ramp to 100%.

deploy-bot: Traffic shifting: 25% -> 50% -> 100% (automated ramp).

deploy-bot: Staging deploy complete.
commit: 0a1b2c3d4e
tag: v2.8.1-staging-rc4
duration: 17m
notes: No DB changes, model/reranker upgrade with config tweak applied during canary, smoke passed after timeout increase, pinned version in staging for validation.
links: runbook https://runbooks.internal/redwood/staging-deploy-ride-along, CI artifacts https://ci.internal/builds/4587

elena: Thanks everyone. I'll run the end-to-end sample tests and report any regressions. :thumbsup:

priya: LGTM, will monitor for 30m and then sign off.

marc: Noted. If anything crops up we have the rollback tag: `v2.8.1-staging-rc3` ready.

deploy-bot: If rollback needed, use `/deploy rollback staging v2.8.1-staging-rc3` and notify #eng-oncall.
